releaseNotes: Fixed a live PII-handling contradiction in the emotional-design knowledge graph: four files independently defined the PostHog event contract for the required Experience Cards using three incompatible property schemas for the same event name, commitment_made — one hashed the user's goal text, one sent it raw as commitment_value, one sent only a character count. emotional-experience-measurement.md is now the sole canonical source for all four cards' event names and properties (it already used the privacy-conservative, no-raw-text schema); consumer-product-design-agency.md's Analytics Contract table and emotional-experience-design.md's four per-card event lines now point to it instead of restating conflicting properties, closing the same drift pattern across all four cards, not just the one with the PII conflict.

A local audit of every shipped business checked out on the maintainer's machine (including Ocho, live since 2026-05-29) found no existing implementation of the conflicting commitment_made event under any of the three schemas, so no production analytics or PostHog data needed remediation — this fix closes the gap before the next business ships against it, rather than correcting an already-shipped mistake.
